clue.text: Mini taken by environmentalist crew (imagined threat to our planet?)

explanation.definitionFit: Small green men from Mars are the stock comic image of alien invaders, a fanciful danger to Earth.

clue.text: Schism involved with war — sailor's work?

taken as written
